prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1468; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the side-impact collision at the intersection referenced in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is now receiving medical care, and we are handling all matters related to the claim on their behalf. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office and do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. We also ask that your insurer preserve all evidence relating to the loss, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or surveillance footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair or total-loss records. Please confirm in writing within fourteen days that these materials are being retained and that our requests have been received.
